One report didn\'t arrive. That happens on a shared mesh. The next one is due around %1$s.
The tag on the cable is waiting for firmware. It can\'t report until it restarts. If you didn\'t mean to update it, press its reset button once.
The tag on the cable is in download mode, so its firmware isn\'t running.
The battery is below 3.25 V, so the tag stays silent to avoid restarting. It reports again by itself above 3.35 V or on a charger.
The tag restarted %1$d times in a row (%2$s). After each restart it waits longer before the first report, now %3$s. A weak battery or a loose connector is the usual reason.
Connected to this phone. Last report %1$s, the next one %2$s.
The tag\'s report counter is far ahead of the app\'s, so the app can\'t find its reports.
This app reads reports from firmware %2$s and newer. The tag has %1$s. Update it over the cable.
This phone has no internet and no MeshCore node, so it can\'t receive reports. Last heard %1$s. The app checks again when the connection is back.

plurals.name: dg_card_relays_down
plurals.item: Your relay doesn\'t answer. Reports that bridges published wait there.
None of your %1$d relays answers. Reports that bridges published wait there.

resources.string: The phone couldn\'t receive from %1$s to %2$s. Asking the relays for reports from that time.
A bridge heard the tag at %1$s (%2$s), but the report isn\'t on your relays. The tag works.
A bridge heard the tag at %1$s (%2$s), but the report isn\'t on your relays. The tag works. Add one of the bridge\'s relays to get its reports.
This phone heard the tag over Bluetooth at %1$s, and the tag sees one of your devices. It stays quiet while you are near and reports by %2$s at the latest.
Over Bluetooth at %1$s the tag said it sees one of your devices. It stays quiet while you are near and reports by %2$s at the latest.
This phone heard the tag start up at %1$s. The first report comes about 30 s after a restart.
The tag restarted at %1$s. A weak battery is the usual reason.
An update started at %1$s and the tag hasn\'t reported since. It may still be in update mode, where it waits without a time limit. Plug it into this phone to check.
The last report at %1$s said %2$s. Below about 7 %% the tag stops reporting. Charge it.
You changed the schedule to %1$s. Until the tag confirms it, the next report can come on either schedule, by %2$s at the latest.
The tag reports %1$s. The app has %2$s. Commands may miss the tag until both agree.
Settings you changed still have to be written over the cable. Until then the tag keeps its old schedule.
The last two reports heard no repeater, so the tag may be out of mesh range. It keeps trying %1$s.
This tag\'s reports came through your own MeshCore node, and it hasn\'t been connected since %1$s.
The tag goes quiet when it sees your devices, and the report that says so may have been lost. This phone can ask it over Bluetooth at its next wake-up, around %1$s.
The tag goes quiet when it sees your devices, and the report that says so may have been lost.

Nothing since the tag was on the cable at %1$s. If it was updated from a computer, it may still be in update mode. Plug it into this phone to check.
